## E — Market signal: your driving privilege and other important information: points, habitual offenders, occupational licenses, reinstatement, seat belts, child seats and insurance
Market research was not performed in this state worker pass and no CompetitiveIntel artifact was supplied, so the market pack for this topic is typed debt (WI-PRIVILEGE-MARKET).
Open items: applicant volume, pass rates, seasonality, buyer persona, price expectations, verbatim voice-of-customer quotes, ad hooks and the named gap.

No market figures are asserted; every figure waits for a sourced recon pass.
